links.comparator_used: qwen2.5:7b without retrieval augmentation (model knowledge alone)
links.effect: RAG raised qwen2.5:7b accuracy to 79.3% (χ²1=31.11, P<.001), with 85.9% retrieval precision
links.quote: RAG implementation enhanced qwen2.5:7b's accuracy to 79.3% (χ²1=31.11, P<.001) with 85.9% retrieval precision.

links.tradeoff: The low-parameter distilled reasoning model showed substantial performance limitations.
links.quote: The distilled model Deepseek-R1:7b markedly underperformed (9.9% vs qwen2.5:7b; χ²1=42.19, P<.001).
